notes.title: A new game update on 2018-11-02
notes.notes:
Hello there...

According to users feed back the following features has been added/and bugs fixed:

1- now the game registers an error if it won't start on windows 10. the error message could be found in the game folder under log/errorlog.txt.

2- the leader board now shows the best 100 scores.

3- added keyboard redefine functionality.

4- made the space ship shooting sound softer.

5- now if you get hit by an enemy you are still capable of collecting power ups.

Thank you all for playing the game any further feed back is highly appreciated.

yours sincerely

ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: A new game update on 2018-10-21
notes.notes:
Hello everyone...

According to feedback I added few features and improvements to the game. These are listed below:

1- The game asks for player name at the beginning so that it is used in storing player's high score.
2- added different types of backgrounds to give variety to the game.
3- the shield now is rendered as a force field around the ship to help the player identify how dangerous this situation is.
4- added homing missile weapon.
5- added ground units that attacks the player.
6- added few other stages.
7- fixed few bugs.

thanks again for all of you and have fun ːsteamhappyː
